We will begin by loading the packages that we will need:

```{r, eval = FALSE}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(spatialGE)
library(ggpubr)
```

Package    | Use
---------- |-------------
[here](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/here/refman/here.html){target="_blank"}      | Constructs paths within project
[tidyverse](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/tidyverse/refman/tidyverse.html){target="_blank"}      | Data wrangling
[readr](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/readr/refman/readr.html){target="_blank"} | Reading in data
[dplyr](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/dplyr/refman/dplyr.html){target="_blank"} | Data wrangling
[sf](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/sf/refman/sf.html){target="_blank"} | Enables storing and working with spatial data
[rhdf5](https://www.bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/vignettes/rhdf5/inst/doc/rhdf5.html){target="_blank"} | Reading and working with HDF5 files
[Matrix](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/Matrix/refman/Matrix.html){target="_blank"} | Working with sparse and dense matrices
[spatialGE](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/spatialGE/refman/spatialGE.html){target="_blank"} | Package for QC, normalization, filtering, visualization, and analysis of spatiallly-resolved gene expression data
[ggpubr](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/ggpubr/refman/ggpubr.html){target="_blank"} | Further functions to customize and prepare ggplot2 plots for publication

The first time we use a function, we will use the `::` to indicate which package we are using. Unless we have overlapping function names, this is not necessary, but we will include it here to be informative about where the functions we will use come from.
